title: The Mock Coronation
text: The apostates are crowning a goat as the Ruler of the Pact, robed in stolen velvet, its horns gilded, while the crowd howls with laughter. They want a noble to place the crown for the joke of it. They have noticed your colours.

options.label: The shrewdest plays along and crowns the goat, for the sake of passage.

outcomes.text: The crowd roars and lets you through as friends. Somewhere the joke is heard, and something takes it seriously.

options.label: Refuse with dignity; you will not mock the Pact for anyone's amusement.

outcomes.text: First they are offended. Then they are armed.

options.label: Steal the crown in the uproar while everyone is laughing.

outcomes.text: Under the paint it is real gold. The whole mob comes after you, and they are not laughing now.
